notes: CO-OP AMMO IS SHARED: ammo dropped by zombies shows up for everyone, and whoever grabs it picks it up for the whole squad - every player gets the ammo. Buying the Ammo Crate refills the whole squad too.
CO-OP SOUND: you now hear your teammates' gunshots (they were silent before), their footsteps, their grenade explosions and their punches, from where they are.
